enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +9: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +9 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Protection +8: Passive: +8 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.

Shield +9: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +9 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.

Proof Against Disease +6: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).
Epic Siren's Ward: 2 Pieces Equipped:+10% Artifact bonus to Armor Class+3 Artifact bonus to all Saving Throws+3 Artifact bonus to Shield Armor Class
